prompts: Use case: productivity-visual. Create one finished 16:9 widescreen virtual camera background for a professional A.R.E presentation, ideally 1920x1080 or 2048x1152. Input image 1 is the original A.R.E logo, a strict identity reference: preserve the exact three separate polygon shapes, two ice-blue strokes and electric blue upper-right stroke; do not invent a different A. Use the mark without the rounded-square tile if needed. Input image 2 is the original blue holographic brain/engine artwork, supporting asset reference. Keep the central 50% of the frame and lower middle calm and low detail for a live speaker's head and shoulders. Put branding entirely in the upper-left safe region, inset at least 7%, occupying about 22% frame width; symbol beside crisp text exactly 'A.R.E' and smaller 'Agent Reasoning Engine'. Logo and typography should remain legible at webcam size. No person, no furniture obscuring the speaker area, no fake interface, no additional text, no watermark. Render one full-bleed background, not a mockup, not a triptych. Direction 1 — MINIMAL DARK: elegant matte midnight-navy backdrop, subtle architectural gradient, very fine blue light wash along far right edge. Upper-left brand lockup clean and flat. On the far right, a restrained low-opacity holographic brain-engine sculpture based on image 2, contained in rightmost 24% of frame, subtle and secondary. Quiet premium keynote aesthetic; near-black navy #0c1421, icy #c4e5ff and restrained electric #218bfa. No busy grid.
